I'm interested in extending some of the results in Foundations/Relation — this is a thread to document intentions / coordinate / get feedback / etc

my first thought is to generalise the results of Confluence to refer to Commute, then specialising to the case where the two relations are the same — would that be welcome? (cc @Chris Henson in particular.) for instance, Newmann's lemma becomes:

def LocallyCommute (r s : α → α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ {x y y' : α}, r x y → s x y' → ∃ z, ReflTransGen s y z ∧ ReflTransGen r y' z

theorem newmann {r s : α → α → Prop} (h : LocallyCommute r s) (h' : Terminating (r ⊔ s)) :
    Commute r s := sorry

looking more thoroughly at Confluence.lean, a couple of other issues i can see:

  • some naming problems (mostly with capitalisation) — would fixes to this need a deprecation?
  • i think we need a new file splitting out the results of termination from confluence, the current location makes them somewhat hard to find — that can happen right away i guess

Any generalizations from single relations to commuting versions are very much welcome! (I think the progression here was that I added the single-relation versions first and then anticipated we'd want Commute for beta-eta reduction, but didn't generalize all the proofs)

For naming of theorems and modules: all of these quirks are probably due to me and should be fixed (in separate PRs from generalizations where appropriate). We haven't been leaving deprecations for renamed theorems so far, but maybe this is a good time to start? I'll leave that to your discretion.

One other orthogonal thing to consider: there have been several Mathlib PRs recently where folks have wanted to add material about confluence (examples are #42293 and #40368), so it seems like there is a desire for some upstreaming to happen. I think for instance theorems like docs#Relation.church_rosser in Mathlib could be a little nicer to state (and name!) with some of the definitions we have.

okay great! i thought as much re the Commute stuff — i'll try to keep things digestible but i don't think (at least i hope!) there should be anything too heavy to review. i've started with cslib#855 which just simplifies some proofs, mostly using mathlib equivalents spelt using ≤ rather than explicit implications.

re upstreaming, i think your comments pointing contributors to our versions are a sensible approach — to my eyes (as i think you said was the consensus on zulip) this stuff feels out-of-scope for mathlib
I'd like to pr η-postpone theorems soon: https://github.com/awesome-lambda-calculus/cslib/blob/sn_eta_step/Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Untyped/Abstract.lean

Next step is cslib#879 which shuffles the file system a bit — mostly to make sure that Confluence really only contains results about confluence. Excuse the somewhat intimidating diff, the only change to declarations is to deprecate MJoin.refl in favour of _root_.refl, which I missed on the previous pass.

Possibly the short files Euclidean, Preserves and Domain could be folded into Basic, but I'm not fussed with how it is.

& finally cslib#880 generalising most of Confluence to Commute — i'd particularly appreciate a review from @lengyijun, does include the results you were interested in for your eta-postponement PR? if not i'm more than happy to co-author this one or modify it to fit with your application.

It doesn’t include the results I need yet. I’ll wait for your PR to be merged, and then I’ll submit the definitions I need in a follow-up PR:

https://github.com/awesome-lambda-calculus/cslib/blob/sn_eta_step/Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Untyped/Abstract.lean

I’m not entirely sure yet whether the names of these postpone relations are the right ones.

hmm okay — looking more closely at your results LocalPostpone A B is the same as DiamondCommute (swap B) A (& analogously for others), so you should be able to derive them from what's in the PR.

in particular, the conclusion of the result you mention in the docstring is roughly ReflTransGen (A ⊔ B) ≤ Comp A B (for any mixed sequence of reductions, the B steps can be postponed), which follows from one of the commute_equivalents in the PR: ReflTransGen (r₁ ⊔ swap r₂) ≤ MHJoin r₁ r₂ by setting r₂ = swap r₂ and using hJoin_eq_comp_swap and that swap (swap r₂) = r₂.

def WeakPostpone (r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x y z⦄, r₂ y x → r₁ y z →
    ∃ w, TransGen r₁ x w ∧ ReflTransGen r₂ z w

def WeakPlusPostpone (r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x y z⦄, r₂ y x → Relation.TransGen r₁ y z →
    ∃ w, Relation.TransGen r₁ x w ∧ ReflTransGen r₂ z w

These two definitions are still needed. Should I add them to Relation/Defs.lean?

Also, what would be good names for them?
